an3.92:1.1: tīṇīmāni bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni
an3.92:1.3: idha bhikkhave kassako gahapati sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ
an3.92:1.4: sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ sīghasīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti
an3.92:1.5: sīghasīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ udakaṃ abhinetipi apanetipi
an3.92:1.6: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:1.7: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā
an3.92:1.8: ajjeva me dhaññāni jāyantu sveva gabbhiniyo hontu uttarasve pacantūti
an3.92:1.9: athakho bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni utupariṇāmīni jāyantipi gabbhinīpi honti pacantipi.
an3.92:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave tīṇīmāni bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni
an3.92:2.4: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:2.5: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā
an3.92:2.6: ajjeva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarasve vāti
an3.92:2.7: athakho bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa bhikkhuno adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an3.92:3.2: tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne tibbo no chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāneti
